answer: To fake identities, an attacker must acquire distinct seeds and lock fresh bonds at the summit of the staking curve, making each sybil cost real capital plus compute. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose answer is derived from a unique raven-signed seed, then post it in a verifiable thread that peers can audit. Cheapest honest path stays single identity, so duplication loses money. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
